translations.web: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.
translations.bsb: For if what was fading away came with glory, how much greater is the glory of that which endures!
translations.kjv: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.
translations.asv: For if that which passeth away was with glory, much more that which remaineth is in glory.
